changelog:
- Enhanced documentation to clarify command usage, agent workflow, and error handling.
- Added instructions for proper handling of tokens, including privacy guidelines.
- Included new commands for querying task status and waiting for completion.
- Expanded error and status code explanations for improved troubleshooting.
- Added sample configuration, quota, and usage details.
- Bundled agent workflow best practices for interacting with the CLI and serving user needs.
summary: Use clip2md to configure an access token, save web pages or article URLs as Markdown clipping tasks, check remaining daily/permanent quota, query task status, and wait for clipping completion or failure. Use when the user mentions clip2md, 剪藏, clip, 保存网页为 Markdown, 查询额度, 提交链接, 查询任务, 等待剪藏完成, or wants
